description: Happy path. A realistic backend/AI engineering role covering all five requirement categories, a mix of must-have and nice-to-have, and a compound skills sentence that must be split into separate atomic requirements. Entirely fictional; no real company or person. Re-keyed from jd-extraction-v1 to jd-extraction-v2 when the prompt was broadened to accept informal, non-English screening criteria; the expected reply for this input is unchanged by that broadening.
jd_text: Senior Backend Engineer - AI Platform
Northwind Analytics (fictional company, sample posting)
About the role
We are building the data and inference platform behind our document
understanding products. You will own backend services end to end, from
schema design through to production operation.
What we are looking for
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field
- At least 5 years of professional experience building backend services
- Strong experience with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL and Docker
- Practical experience designing and operating REST APIs in production
- A track record of shipping and maintaining at least one substantial
data-processing or machine-learning system
- Comfortable explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
Nice to have
- Experience with Kubernetes
- Familiarity with vector databases or retrieval systems
- Prior work on document parsing or OCR pipelines
- A Master's degree in a quantitative discipline
We review every application ourselves. Final hiring decisions are made by
our engineering managers.
